notes:
Topline: mid-size EU legaltech that provides contract search and multilingual precedent retrieval across EN/FR/DE/ES/JP. Primary metric = per-language recall@10 and precision@5 for legal clause retrieval. Currently evaluating RAG+rerank approach: dense embeddings store + lightweight transformer reranker for top-50 hits.

Recent calls:
- 2026-02-15 discovery (ff_2026-02-15_auriga_intro): described 200M doc corpus (contracts + memos), ~45M unique fragments; expects heavy tail in DE/FR.
- 2026-02-20 demo (ff_2026-02-20_rerank_demo): ran cross-lingual embedding baseline (mBERT-based) + in-house reranker; Redwood test ran open-quantized model + candidate rerank — 75th pctl latency ~180ms (hosted), POC target <150ms.
- Security touchpoints: shared security questionnaire, legal requires EU-only residency for FR/DE; procurement asked for dedicated VPC + KMS and audit logs.

Customer quotes / paraphrases: "Need consistent per-language recall — English can be good, but we lose DE/FR recall on current vector mapping." "Cost matters — we expect 50M queries/month during peak: need cost model that scales."

Technical constraints & preferences:
- Indexing scale: target index size ~200M fragments; expect incremental weekly ingest ~2M fragments.
- Embedding strategy: plan to evaluate per-language embedding models vs a single cross-lingual backbone (tradeoff: per-language improves DE recall but increases storage/cost).
- Reranking: want light transformer reranker for top-50 candidates; prefer running reranker on CPU-accelerated dedicated pool or small GPUs in private deployment.
- Latency SLA: aim for median <60ms, p75 <150ms for retrieval+rerank in EU region; p99 fallback policy acceptable for background tasks.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement target $0.5 - $0.8 per query (weighted across retrieval+rerank); will accept tiered pricing for reserved capacity.

Operational notes:
- They prefer A/B of per-language models to quantify per-language recall/precision delta.
- Want tooling to compute per-language recall and precision per query set and per-model. Redwood Optimize is of high interest.
- Concern about cross-shard reranks (embedding store partitioned by language) — need guidance on routing and fallback.

POC status:
- POC running (evaluation stage). Trial dataset uploaded (subset ~2M fragments) for EN/DE/FR. Redwood provided initial rerank config and cost estimate. SE to deliver updated quantization recommendations by 2026-03-05.

Next meetings: procurement pricing call (2026-03-04), security STP review (2026-03-10).
notes_summary: Cross-lingual RAG customer with large index, per-language recall concerns, VPC/KMS requirement, aiming for dedicated/private deployment and cost-optimized reranking. Key ask: per-language evaluation metrics + clear cost per-query for combined retrieval+rerank.
